title: Snookum Russell
summary: Snookum Russell's band, his bass playing and his settling in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Well, there's so many guys came out of that band. And Snookum Russell had a big band one time too.

Snookum Russell had a band of his own, all right. Snookum Russell come out of... He's not from your oldest, is he? Yeah. Florida, he's from Florida. Snookum Russell come out of... He's from... Oh, this man got killed in a bus in Ron Jackson, Mississippi. He's from over in the Bahama Islands. I can't imagine who that would be. That's the band Snookum Russell came out of. Snookum Russell used to sing. He used to be what they call in those days a scat singer. Snookum Russell wasn't no piano player. No. He was a bass player too. Upright bass player. Fine upright bass player. So he came to New Orleans after that band broke up? He came here during the time, he came here after that and married a girl. Oh yeah? After his band broke up. He had a band. Oh, he had a band that didn't play in New Orleans, he toured. His band played here. But he did?
Snookum Russell had a fine band. But his New Orleans musicians?
Who? His band? No. He had one fella from here named Henderson, a piano player named Henderson. Andrew Henderson.
Yeah, I didn't know him. He is. So Snookum was playing bass in that band? Who? So Snookum was playing bass in that band?
I don't know. Out there, that's where he's playing bass, yeah. In his own band.

He's a fine bass man. You can hear him on the whole block. Loud, yeah. He's a fine bass man. See? Because I was surprised when I saw him playing piano. Yeah. Because I knew he was the bass man. But he married Steve's daughter.
Steve who? Angle. Oh yeah? Sure. Sure.
And when was that? When was that when he came here?
He must have been here about 20, 20, 20, 20, 25 years now.
I guess. And then he stopped playing. He didn't have a band anymore.

No, he went down on Brooklyn Street and he started working and he built a home somewhere. He bought a home. Got nine and bought a home somewhere. Out here somebody just had a private somewhere. Set a line.
